title_zh: 我只是还不会，不是不行
title_en: Psychology Made Simple (12/20): I Just Can't Do It Yet
note_en: 只要多重复几次，就能记住 "if I go over them a few more times, I'll remember them" uses 只要…就…: 只要 names a condition that is enough on its own, and 就 introduces the guaranteed result. Don't confuse it with 只有…才… ("only if"): 只要 means "as long as" (this is sufficient), while 只有 means "only if" (this is required).
